name: Instagram Prompt Creator - Additive v1
description: Original non-explicit Reels direction options. Import with Upload JSON to merge; no defaults or existing IDs are replaced.
usage_notes: Import this file using the existing Upload JSON control. The importer merges groups and options and keeps existing selections.
Every new option ID starts ig-. Every new group ID starts ig-. Existing groups are extended without changing their mode, defaults, or old options.
Select a Reel format and only the relevant action specialty; leave unrelated action groups at None to avoid conflicting instructions.
Use the existing Camera movement, Framing, Lighting, Time & pace, Voice treatment, Soundscape, and Music controls for exclusive choices.
No new option is selected automatically. Importing again does not duplicate options.
Finishing choices are labeled as plans. They do not claim the generation model performs captions, cuts, interpolation, audio mux, or licensed-track reuse.
Use your own scene summary, source links, exact dialogue, product facts, and desired actions. The pack never fetches or inspects references.
The taxonomy is broad rather than exhaustive or a real-time popularity ranking. It contains no promise of reach, engagement, or model execution.
Saved upstream MiniMax guides informed reference roles and sound separation; all option prose is independently authored.

research_sources.title: Meta - Introducing Instagram Reels
research_sources.used_for: Foundational format vocabulary: clips, audio, transitions, alignment and speed. Historical duration limits are not used.

research_sources.title: Meta - Reels creative essentials
research_sources.used_for: Vertical composition, clear audio and interface-safe visual information; no performance statistics are imported.

research_sources.title: Adobe Express - Better social media videos
research_sources.used_for: Hook, focused story, behind-the-scenes and clear closing structure.

research_sources.title: Canva - Beginner guide to Instagram Reels
research_sources.used_for: Broad creator formats and video assembly vocabulary. Older platform-length and ranking claims are not used.

research_sources.title: Meta - Best practices for Instagram creators
research_sources.used_for: Keep account-specific recommendations distinct from a reusable generic option library.

research_sources.title: MiniMax - Full-reference prompting guide
research_sources.used_for: Consistent reference labels and separate visual, physical sound and music roles; consulted saved project copy.

research_sources.title: MiniMax - Base prompting guide
research_sources.used_for: Concrete ordered actions, camera movement and explicitly supplied speech; consulted saved project copy.

options.label: Outfit of the day (OOTD)
options.text: Use an outfit-of-the-day presentation: show the referenced outfit clearly, give one readable movement, then settle into a composed final pose.

options.label: Get ready with me (GRWM)
options.text: Use a get-ready-with-me moment: {A} performs one user-specified preparation step with casual attention to the camera; preserve the referenced appearance.

options.label: Try-on / styling
options.text: Present one referenced look through a front view and gentle turn; additional outfits require separately supplied looks and separately prepared shots.

options.label: Model walk / runway
options.text: Build a concise fashion presentation around an approach, a controlled pose, and a smooth turn within the available space.

options.label: Beauty routine
options.text: Show one clearly specified beauty-routine step with careful hand placement, a readable application area, and a natural finish.

options.label: Hair styling
options.text: Show a user-specified hair-styling action while keeping the established hair color, length, face, and identity consistent.

options.label: Dance / choreography
options.text: Present a short repeatable dance phrase with a clear starting stance, coordinated movement, and a balanced finish.

options.label: Lip-sync performance
options.text: Prepare an expressive performance for an explicitly supplied lyric or spoken line; do not invent words or infer audio reuse from the motion reference.

options.label: Mini vlog
options.text: Treat the shot as a candid mini-vlog moment with a clear activity, one observable development, and a natural closing reaction.

options.label: Day in the life
options.text: Show one recognizable moment from the user's described daily routine; keep the current shot coherent rather than compressing a whole day into one take.

options.label: Morning routine
options.text: Present one user-specified morning activity with an unhurried start, a purposeful gesture, and a calm finish.

options.label: Evening / wind-down routine
options.text: Present one user-specified wind-down activity with relaxed timing and small, believable physical adjustments.

options.label: How-to / tutorial
options.text: Demonstrate one user-specified practical step from setup through action to its visible result; keep the important hand or object movement readable.

options.label: Tips / checklist
options.text: Stage a clear creator presentation for user-supplied tips, with distinct gestures and pauses; add exact wording later or supply a complete speech script.

options.label: Explainer / educational
options.text: Use a focused explanatory presentation with calm eye contact and one clear demonstration tied to the user's topic.

options.label: Storytime
options.text: Use a conversational storytime performance with an attentive opening, a visible change of expression, and an understated closing reaction; use only supplied narrative facts.

options.label: POV scenario
options.text: Stage the user's specified point-of-view situation through clear eyelines and a simple physical interaction without inventing hidden context.

options.label: Comedy skit
options.text: Use a small visual setup, a readable surprise, and a reaction pause; let the physical timing carry the joke without adding unsupplied dialogue.

options.label: Reaction video
options.text: Hold attention on {A}'s reaction to the user-specified event, progressing from noticing to recognition and a clear final response.

options.label: Interview / Q&A
options.text: Stage a two-person interview with distinct eyelines and turns of attention; questions and answers must come from the user's script.

options.label: Two-person collaboration
options.text: Give {A} and {B} complementary actions with distinct screen positions, readable handoffs, and no accidental merging.

options.label: Behind the scenes
options.text: Show a believable preparation or working moment tied to the user's described process, keeping the tools and workspace faithful to the references.

options.label: Making / process video
options.text: Focus on one stage of making something, showing the tool approach, the contact, and the small resulting change continuously.

options.label: Reveal / transformation
options.text: Build anticipation around an already supplied result, then make it clearly visible; a different before-and-after state needs its own supplied reference.

options.label: Before / after comparison
options.text: Prepare a matched-composition comparison in finishing using separately supplied before and after states; this generated shot retains its own referenced state.

options.label: Unboxing
options.text: Show {A} opening the specified package carefully, revealing the supplied item, and pausing so the item can be read visually.

options.label: Product review
options.text: Present the referenced item through a neutral demonstration and a reaction appropriate to user-supplied findings; do not invent performance claims or a testimonial.

options.label: Product demonstration
options.text: Show one genuine user-specified use of the item, keeping its shape, controls, labels, and contact points consistent.

options.label: Creator / UGC-style presentation
options.text: Use a natural creator presentation with approachable eye contact, modest hand gestures, and a clear view of the supplied item; do not invent personal experience.

options.label: Haul / favorites
options.text: Present one referenced item at a time; prepare additional supplied items as separate takes for a later haul sequence.

options.label: Recipe / cooking
options.text: Show one specified cooking step with visible utensils, plausible quantities, clear contact, and continuous food geometry.

options.label: Workout / movement demo
options.text: Show one user-specified exercise repetition at a controlled pace with readable alignment and a stable finish; do not invent fitness results.

options.label: Travel / destination
options.text: Show a specific supplied location through one purposeful movement or reveal, preserving its architecture and spatial relationships.

options.label: Room / property tour
options.text: Guide attention through the supplied space with a simple movement and a clear point of interest, without inventing additional rooms.

options.label: Pet / animal moment
options.text: Show a small user-described animal behavior with species-appropriate motion and stable anatomy; do not force human facial expressions.

options.label: Nature / outdoor moment
options.text: Let a specified natural detail develop through restrained movement while keeping the supplied environment coherent.

options.label: ASMR / satisfying process
options.text: Make one precise visible action easy to follow, using restrained close physical sounds and continuous material behavior.

options.label: Art / craft reveal
options.text: Show a user-supplied art or craft process or finished piece with careful hand placement and a readable final presentation.

options.label: Music / instrument performance
options.text: Stage a user-specified musical gesture with plausible instrument handling; exact fingering, lyrics, and soundtrack require explicit supplied material.

options.label: Event / celebration
options.text: Capture a user-specified celebration moment through clear reactions and one readable action without inventing guests or signage.

options.label: Announcement / launch
options.text: Use a composed creator presentation and a clear reveal of the supplied subject or item; factual announcement wording is supplied separately.

options.label: Motivational / reflective
options.text: Use a grounded reflective performance with purposeful posture, measured movement, and an understated sense of resolution, without fabricated quotes.

options.label: Recap / highlight
options.text: Create a clear highlight moment suitable for a later recap; additional moments are assembled from separate supplied or generated takes.

options.label: Seamless visual loop
options.text: Design one cyclical movement that returns close to its opening composition and pace, without reversing gravity or causing an abrupt pose reset.

options.label: Start mid-action
options.text: Begin with the specified action already visibly underway, then make its purpose clear through the next movement.

options.label: Result first
options.text: Make the user-supplied completed result visible immediately, then use a small gesture to direct attention to it.

options.label: Immediate eye contact
options.text: Begin with a steady, friendly look into the lens before the main action develops.

options.label: Walk into frame
options.text: Begin with clear space, then let {A} enter naturally and arrive at the main presentation position.

options.label: Turn toward viewer
options.text: Open with {A} slightly turned away; turn toward the lens with smooth head and shoulder coordination.

options.label: Foreground detail
options.text: Start attention on an existing foreground detail, then reveal the relationship to the subject through a modest camera or subject movement.

options.label: Bring item into view
options.text: Raise the supplied item into a clear viewing position with a continuous hand path and a brief hold.

options.label: Gesture-led reveal
options.text: Use one small uncovering or indicating gesture to reveal an existing reference detail without a scene transformation.

options.label: Reaction first
options.text: Begin with an immediately readable reaction, then direct the gaze toward the user-specified cause.

options.label: Deliberate opening pause
options.text: Use a brief composed opening beat, followed by one purposeful action; keep breathing and balance alive.

options.label: Hands already working
options.text: Open on hands already performing the specified task, with the object and contact point visible.

options.label: Approach and stop
options.text: Let {A} take a short approach toward the camera and stop smoothly before entering an uncomfortably close distance.

options.label: Partial reveal
options.text: Initially obscure a small part of the supplied item with a natural hand position, then uncover it without changing the item.

options.label: Visual contrast
options.text: Make the user's supplied contrast readable through placement and action without inventing a new before or after state.

options.label: Setup / action / payoff
options.text: Make the sequence legible as an initial situation, one purposeful action, and a visible consequence within the chosen duration.

options.label: Problem / demonstration / result
options.text: Use only the user-specified problem and outcome; show the practical demonstration clearly between them.

options.label: Question / demonstration
options.text: Give an inquisitive opening look, demonstrate the user-specified point, then finish with a clear confirming gesture; no invented spoken question.

options.label: Anticipation / reveal
options.text: Build a short anticipation beat through gaze and hands, reveal the supplied detail, and hold the result.

options.label: Small progress arc
options.text: Show one observable incremental improvement in the specified action without claiming a broader transformation.

options.label: Three visual beats
options.text: Give the performance a readable introduction, development, and final beat, scaled to the selected {duration}-second duration.

options.label: One tip only
options.text: Keep the whole shot focused on one user-supplied practical idea rather than adding unrelated gestures or topics.

options.label: Action / reaction
options.text: Make the specified action clear first, then leave a readable reaction beat before ending.

options.label: Show instead of explain
options.text: Let a simple, visible user-specified action communicate the idea without invented dialogue or text.

options.label: Open-ended continuation
options.text: End with a natural continuation cue while retaining complete, physically plausible movement through the final frame.

options.label: Handheld selfie style
options.text: Use a believable front-facing phone perspective with restrained handheld drift; keep face proportions stable.

options.label: Phone on tripod
options.text: Use an eye-level phone-on-tripod perspective with a stable horizon and relaxed creator presence.

options.label: Mirror presentation
options.text: When the reference includes a mirror, keep reflected geometry, handedness, phone placement, and identity consistent as {A} poses.

options.label: Talking-head framing
options.text: Use a direct-to-lens presentation with small natural gestures; actual speech occurs only from a separately supplied exact script.

options.label: Hands-only demonstration
options.text: Keep the activity and hands prominent without introducing an unseen face or additional body parts into the composition.

options.label: Overhead process
options.text: Use the supplied overhead working composition with clear hand paths and enough space around the specified activity.

options.label: Desk creator
options.text: Present the specified desk activity with restrained posture changes and a clear relationship between hands, tools, and workspace.

options.label: Walk-and-talk posture
options.text: Use a gentle walking creator presentation with controlled body bounce; actual spoken words require the user's exact script.

options.label: Candid observer
options.text: Let {A} remain engaged in the user-described activity rather than continually acknowledging the camera.

options.label: Host / presenter
options.text: Use welcoming posture, purposeful gestures, and a short presentation hold around the supplied topic or object.

options.label: Natural phone video
options.text: Keep a natural smartphone-video appearance with believable skin texture, restrained processing, and stable exposure.

options.label: Fashion editorial
options.text: Use deliberate posing and clean visual emphasis on the referenced look while preserving identity, outfit, and environment.

options.label: Cinematic realism
options.text: Use controlled contrast, smooth tonal rolloff, and natural detail without altering the referenced scene's contents.

options.label: Documentary realism
options.text: Retain an observational, lightly polished appearance with natural texture and credible physical behavior.

options.label: Clean minimal
options.text: Keep attention on the existing subject through restrained motion and clear composition; do not remove reference objects automatically.

options.label: Cozy lifestyle
options.text: Use an intimate, relaxed performance and gentle visual contrast without replacing the supplied environment or light source.

options.label: Bright and airy treatment
options.text: Use restrained highlight handling and an open tonal treatment without changing reference light direction or clipping skin detail.

options.label: Moody editorial treatment
options.text: Use subdued midtones and restrained contrast without crushing visible detail or changing reference light direction.

options.label: Subtle film texture
options.text: Apply restrained fine grain and gentle highlight rolloff while keeping color, geometry, and exposure temporally stable.

options.label: Retro home-video finish
options.text: Finishing treatment: add a restrained home-video texture later; preserve clean native generation without burned-in timestamps or tracking damage.

options.label: Understated luxury
options.text: Use controlled movement, uncluttered visual emphasis, and detailed material rendering without adding brands or expensive objects.

options.label: Athletic energy
options.text: Use purposeful, precise physical timing and clear motion readability while retaining the chosen camera and reference framing.

options.label: Playful creator style
options.text: Use light expressive timing and approachable reactions without cartoon anatomy or unrequested visual effects.

options.label: Soft dreamy finish
options.text: Finishing treatment: use subtle diffusion and restrained color softness later, preserving readable faces and stable native detail.

options.label: Front-facing outfit hold
options.text: {A} settles into a relaxed front-facing stance so the referenced outfit is readable, keeping fingers and shoulders natural.

options.label: Quarter-turn outfit view
options.text: {A} makes a controlled quarter turn, pauses to show the side silhouette, then settles without changing the outfit.

options.label: Turn and look back
options.text: {A} turns enough to show the referenced back silhouette, then looks back naturally over one shoulder without twisting the neck excessively.

options.label: Editorial weight shift
options.text: {A} shifts weight from one leg to the other with a small hip adjustment, relaxed shoulders, and stable foot contact.

options.label: Cross-step pose
options.text: {A} takes a small controlled cross-step, holds balance, and relaxes into the pose without intersecting legs or feet.

options.label: Step out / step back
options.text: {A} takes one short step outward to open the silhouette, pauses, then returns to a balanced stance.

options.label: Walk / stop / pose
options.text: {A} takes a few natural model-walk steps, decelerates, holds one pose, and settles smoothly.

options.label: Heel-to-toe pivot
options.text: {A} pivots through the feet with believable friction and coordinated shoulders, finishing in a comfortable stance.

options.label: Adjust existing lapel / collar
options.text: If the referenced outfit has a collar or lapel, {A} adjusts it once with a light touch; do not add a garment feature.

options.label: Adjust existing sleeve
options.text: If the referenced garment has a sleeve, {A} makes one small sleeve adjustment with believable fabric contact.

options.label: Show existing garment drape
options.text: {A} lightly holds an existing garment edge to show its drape, keeping the outfit design and coverage unchanged.

options.label: Hand to existing pocket
options.text: If a pocket exists in the reference, {A} places one hand naturally into it without creating a new pocket or hiding extra fingers.

options.label: Seated fashion pose
options.text: {A} settles into the referenced seat with relaxed leg placement, clear limb separation, and a small composed posture adjustment.

options.label: Present existing accessory
options.text: {A} briefly presents a referenced accessory while preserving its identity, shape, and attachment points; do not introduce a new item.

options.label: Show referenced footwear
options.text: Make a small foot placement change that reveals the existing footwear without lifting into an unstable or impossible stance.

options.label: Gentle fabric sway
options.text: {A} makes a restrained body turn that allows the existing garment to sway naturally and settle under gravity.

options.label: Step-touch groove
options.text: {A} performs a short step-touch phrase with alternating weight transfers and relaxed coordinated arms.

options.label: Two-step groove
options.text: {A} repeats a compact two-step pattern with grounded foot contact and a steady, comfortable rhythm.

options.label: Side-to-side sway
options.text: {A} sways gently side to side, allowing knees, hips, and shoulders to follow a coherent balanced rhythm.

options.label: Simple arm choreography
options.text: {A} performs a short repeatable arm phrase with clear hand shapes and smooth elbow and shoulder coordination.

options.label: Shoulder groove
options.text: {A} makes a restrained alternating shoulder groove with relaxed hands and a stable torso.

options.label: Hand choreography
options.text: {A} performs a simple hand-gesture phrase at chest height with fingers separated and wrists bending naturally.

options.label: Walking groove
options.text: {A} combines a few natural forward steps with a small rhythmic upper-body groove and a stable finish.

options.label: Pivot and groove
options.text: {A} makes one modest pivot, returns to a readable frontal stance, and continues the same short groove.

options.label: Pose / groove / freeze
options.text: {A} starts in a clear pose, performs one compact movement phrase, and finishes in a balanced held pose with natural breathing.

options.label: Partner mirroring
options.text: {A} and {B} perform a simple mirrored movement phrase with distinct silhouettes and consistent spacing.

options.label: Movement call-and-response
options.text: {A} performs a compact gesture phrase, then {B} answers with the same phrase while the first subject pauses naturally.

options.label: Follow supplied rhythm broadly
options.text: Use only the broad timing and energy of an explicitly supplied motion reference; preserve image-defined identity, wardrobe, and scene.

options.label: Brush application
options.text: Using the user-specified referenced brush and application area, {A} makes a controlled application motion with gentle surface contact.

options.label: Skincare application
options.text: {A} applies the specified product through small gentle motions, keeping facial structure and skin texture stable.

options.label: Tuck hair behind ear
options.text: {A} tucks an existing section of hair behind one ear and lets the hand lower naturally without changing the hairstyle.

options.label: Gentle hair sweep
options.text: {A} lightly guides existing hair away from the face, maintaining hair length, density, and realistic strand motion.

options.label: Comb / brush hair
options.text: {A} guides the specified hair tool through the existing hair with continuous contact and no abrupt length or style changes.

options.label: Mirror check
options.text: {A} checks the referenced mirror, makes one small user-specified adjustment, and relaxes into a satisfied neutral expression.

options.label: Beauty product presentation
options.text: {A} holds the supplied product steadily near a clear viewing position without deforming fingers or inventing readable label text.

options.label: Product texture detail
options.text: Show a small amount of the supplied product moving naturally on the specified surface without changing its user-described consistency.

options.label: Finished-look hold
options.text: {A} gently turns the face to show the referenced finished look, preserving makeup placement, complexion, and facial proportions.

options.label: Pick up and present
options.text: {A} picks up the referenced item, adjusts to a plausible grip, and holds it in a clear viewing position.

options.label: Rotate item slowly
options.text: {A} rotates the supplied item slowly through a small angle while keeping its geometry and label placement fixed.

options.label: Place item carefully
options.text: {A} lowers the referenced item onto the specified existing surface with visible contact and a natural hand release.

options.label: Open lid / package
options.text: {A} opens the specified existing lid or package along its real hinge or seam without changing the item's construction.

options.label: Press existing control
options.text: {A} presses the specified existing control once, with believable fingertip contact; show only the user-specified response.

options.label: Two-item comparison
options.text: Place the two user-specified referenced items in a clear comparison arrangement without implying unsupplied superiority claims.

options.label: Point out existing detail
options.text: {A} indicates a specified visible product detail with one restrained finger gesture that does not cover it.

options.label: Natural in-use moment
options.text: Show the referenced item used in the user-specified everyday action, maintaining credible grip, force, and contact.

options.label: Pack an order
options.text: Show one specified order-packing step with continuous object positions and a clear completion beat.

options.label: Flat-lay arrangement
options.text: Arrange only the supplied items in a readable existing workspace, with physically plausible hand placement and no added branding.

options.label: Controlled pour
options.text: Show a steady pour of the specified drink or ingredient with a continuous stream, plausible container angles, and no clipping.

options.label: Stir / mix
options.text: Use a small repeated stirring motion with consistent utensil contact and believable liquid or mixture resistance.

options.label: Slice / cut ingredient
options.text: Show one controlled user-specified cutting action with clear tool contact and continuous ingredient geometry.

options.label: Plate / garnish
options.text: Place the specified food or garnish carefully, keeping the dish arrangement consistent after the hand withdraws.

options.label: Coffee preparation
options.text: Show one specified coffee-preparation step with the supplied equipment and a readable physical result.

options.label: Lift cup / small sip
options.text: {A} lifts the referenced cup with a plausible grip, takes a small natural sip if requested, and lowers it without facial distortion.

options.label: Taste and react
options.text: {A} takes a small user-specified taste and gives a restrained response consistent with the requested tone, without invented review claims.

options.label: Gentle visible steam
options.text: If the user specifies hot food or drink, allow a restrained wisp of steam to drift naturally without obscuring the subject.

options.label: Present finished dish
options.text: {A} presents the supplied finished dish, holds it level, and pauses so its existing details remain readable.

options.label: Gentle warm-up
options.text: {A} performs one user-specified low-impact warm-up movement with controlled range and stable balance.

options.label: Controlled bodyweight squat
options.text: {A} performs one comfortable bodyweight squat with coherent hip and knee movement and a stable return to standing.

options.label: Controlled lunge
options.text: {A} performs one user-specified lunge with visible foot placement, balanced weight transfer, and a controlled return.

options.label: Gentle stretch
options.text: {A} enters the user-specified comfortable stretch gradually, holds without bouncing, and releases smoothly.

options.label: Simple yoga transition
options.text: {A} moves between two user-specified accessible positions with clear support points and no impossible joint angles.

options.label: Breathing / mindfulness
options.text: Use slow natural breathing, relaxed shoulders, and small posture adjustments rather than an entirely frozen body.

options.label: Wellness walk
options.text: {A} takes a short comfortable walk with natural footfalls and relaxed arm swing within the supplied environment.

options.label: Supplied equipment demo
options.text: Show one user-specified use of the referenced exercise equipment with consistent grips and plausible resistance.

options.label: Rest between movements
options.text: {A} relaxes after the user-specified movement with subtle breathing and a natural recovery posture; do not exaggerate exertion.

options.label: Arrival moment
options.text: {A} arrives at the supplied location, pauses to orient, and acknowledges an existing point of interest.

options.label: Look around
options.text: {A} makes a small attentive look around the supplied surroundings without revealing invented architecture beyond the reference.

options.label: Destination stroll
options.text: {A} walks naturally through the available referenced space while retaining its layout and scale.

options.label: Pause at a view
options.text: {A} pauses to take in the supplied view, shifts weight comfortably, and allows the gaze to settle.

options.label: Look through existing window
options.text: If the reference includes a window, {A} glances through it with natural head motion and stable reflection geometry.

options.label: Cafe / dining moment
options.text: Show a user-specified cafe or dining action using only the supplied setting and objects.

options.label: Handle referenced luggage
options.text: {A} adjusts or carries the supplied bag or luggage with believable grip and weight, without introducing travel documents.

options.label: Architectural detail
options.text: Emphasize a supplied architectural feature through a restrained reveal or attention shift without changing perspective abruptly.

options.label: Local experience
options.text: Show one user-described activity at the supplied destination with clear physical participation and no invented cultural claims.

options.label: Tidy one area
options.text: {A} moves one supplied object into its specified place with continuous contact and a small completion pause.

options.label: Clean one surface
options.text: {A} makes a controlled wiping motion on a supplied surface, preserving object layout and material texture.

options.label: Organize referenced items
options.text: {A} arranges the user-specified existing items through sequential hand movements without duplicates appearing.

options.label: Start a desk task
options.text: {A} settles into the referenced desk setup and begins the user-specified activity with natural posture and hand placement.

options.label: Read / turn page
options.text: {A} follows the existing page with the eyes and turns one page naturally, without generating new readable text.

options.label: Care for a plant
options.text: {A} performs the specified gentle plant-care action using supplied tools and maintaining leaf geometry.

options.label: Arrange flowers
options.text: {A} repositions one supplied stem or flower carefully without changing the arrangement's identity or adding new blooms.

options.label: Show a decor detail
options.text: Use a small gesture to highlight the specified existing decor detail while preserving the room layout.

options.label: Ready to leave
options.text: {A} completes one user-specified leaving-home gesture, such as lifting a supplied bag, then moves naturally toward the existing exit.

options.label: Drawing / sketching
options.text: Show a short user-specified drawing action with a stable tool grip and continuous contact; do not invent detailed text or a different finished artwork.

options.label: Paint / brushstroke
options.text: Show one deliberate brushstroke on the supplied work surface with believable pressure and material deposition.

options.label: Craft assembly
options.text: Show one specified assembly step with clear part identities and continuous hand-to-object contact.

options.label: Instrument handling
options.text: {A} performs the user-specified musical gesture with stable instrument geometry and plausible hand placement.

options.label: Photography moment
options.text: {A} handles the referenced camera, aims naturally, and lowers it with believable grip and strap behavior.

options.label: Keyboard / desk work
options.text: {A} makes a short, restrained typing gesture with natural finger separation; keep screen content unspecified or reference-faithful.

options.label: Practical repair step
options.text: Show one user-specified repair action using supplied tools with plausible force and no invented technical instructions.

options.label: Present finished work
options.text: {A} presents the supplied finished piece with a modest adjustment and a clear viewing hold.

options.label: Animal notices something
options.text: The referenced animal makes a small species-appropriate head or ear adjustment toward the user's specified stimulus.

options.label: Animal walking
options.text: The referenced animal takes a few species-appropriate steps with stable anatomy and coherent paw or hoof contact.

options.label: Resting animal
options.text: Use subtle breathing and small natural adjustments appropriate to the supplied animal rather than rigid stillness.

options.label: Gentle animal interaction
options.text: Show only the user-specified gentle interaction, with clear contact and a natural response from the referenced animal.

options.label: Leaves in a light breeze
options.text: If foliage exists in the reference, let a few leaves move subtly in a light breeze and settle naturally.

options.label: Existing water movement
options.text: If water exists in the reference, show small coherent ripples consistent with its scale and the user-specified motion.

options.label: Subtle cloud movement
options.text: If clouds are visible in the reference, allow restrained coherent drift without sudden weather or lighting changes.

options.label: Small greeting wave
options.text: {A} gives a brief relaxed wave with separated fingers and a natural return of the hand.

options.label: Point to supplied item
options.text: {A} points once toward the specified existing item without covering it or crossing the hand through another object.

options.label: Open-palm presentation
options.text: {A} makes a small open-palm presenting gesture with natural wrist alignment and relaxed fingers.

options.label: Hands loosely together
options.text: {A} brings the hands loosely together, adjusts the fingers naturally, then lets them relax.

options.label: Small affirmative nod
options.text: {A} makes one small deliberate nod with coordinated eyes and a stable facial structure.

options.label: Attentive head tilt
options.text: {A} tilts the head slightly as attention shifts, then returns comfortably toward neutral.

options.label: Light shrug
options.text: {A} makes a small shoulder shrug and a restrained expression change without exaggerated anatomy.

options.label: Hand to upper chest
options.text: {A} briefly rests one relaxed hand against the upper chest, then lowers it naturally.

options.label: Inviting hand gesture
options.text: {A} makes a small inviting gesture toward the specified existing area without implying an unrequested scene change.

options.label: Thumbs-up
options.text: {A} gives a brief clear thumbs-up with anatomically consistent fingers and a relaxed arm position.

options.label: Count on fingers
options.text: {A} makes a short user-specified counting gesture with distinct fingers; no numeric text is generated.

options.label: Attentive listening
options.text: {A} listens with a small nod, natural eye movement, and restrained posture adjustments rather than continuous talking gestures.

options.label: Look at lens
options.text: Keep the gaze primarily toward the camera lens with natural blinks and small, believable eye movements.

options.label: Look just off camera
options.text: Keep the gaze slightly beside the lens as if attending to a specified nearby point, without drifting eyes.

options.label: Look at held item
options.text: Let the gaze follow the supplied item as it moves, then return naturally toward the presentation position.

options.label: Glance down then up
options.text: {A} glances toward the user-specified detail, then raises the eyes toward the lens in one continuous movement.

options.label: Follow the hand gesture
options.text: Coordinate the eyes and head with the specified hand gesture so attention leads the action naturally.

options.label: Over-shoulder glance
options.text: {A} gives a modest over-shoulder glance with comfortable neck rotation and stable eyes.

options.label: Look toward partner
options.text: {A} and {B} exchange brief attentive glances with distinct eyelines, then return to their specified activity.

options.label: Notice environment detail
options.text: {A} notices an existing detail in the supplied environment, pauses briefly, and resumes the action.

options.label: Clean hard cut
options.text: Finishing plan: cut between separately prepared takes at a purposeful action boundary; this native take remains continuous.

options.label: Match on action
options.text: Finishing plan: join separate takes at matching stages of the same physical action, retaining natural screen direction.

options.label: Graphic match cut
options.text: Finishing plan: join separately prepared shots using a similar existing shape or composition; do not morph objects in this native take.

options.label: Hand-cover transition
options.text: Finishing plan: join separately prepared takes while a hand naturally covers the lens; retain continuous hand anatomy in each take.

options.label: Foreground object wipe
options.text: Finishing plan: hide the join behind a supplied foreground object passing through frame; do not invent the object in this native take.

options.label: Whip-pan transition
options.text: Finishing plan: match the direction and speed of separately prepared camera pans, joining them during motion blur.

options.label: Turn / spin match
options.text: Finishing plan: join separate takes at a matching body turn with consistent center position and rotation direction.

options.label: Snap-on-beat transition
options.text: Finishing plan: align a user-specified finger snap or gesture with the cut between separately prepared looks; do not transform clothing in this native take.

options.label: Step-through transition
options.text: Finishing plan: cut between separately prepared takes at matching foot positions, preserving scale and walking direction.

options.label: Zoom match
options.text: Finishing plan: join separate takes at matching framing scales using a restrained edit zoom, retaining the clean native source.

options.label: Doorway / occlusion transition
options.text: Finishing plan: hide the join behind an existing doorway edge or occlusion in separately prepared shots.

options.label: Gentle dissolve
options.text: Finishing plan: dissolve between separate shots at a quiet point, avoiding an appearance of merged faces or limbs in native generation.

options.label: Beat-matched cut
options.text: Finishing plan: place a clean cut on a selected beat from separately supplied or licensed music; no source soundtrack is assumed.

options.label: Loop closure
options.text: Finishing plan: join the ending and opening on matching composition, direction, and movement phase after checking the complete native take.

options.label: One continuous take
options.text: Keep one complete continuous take as the finished presentation, retaining the natural action onset and ending.

options.label: Short montage
options.text: Finishing plan: assemble distinct separately prepared moments into a concise montage, keeping this native take free of synthetic cuts.

options.label: Talking-head jump cuts
options.text: Finishing plan: remove pauses from separately recorded or scripted speech at clean boundaries; preserve mouth and gesture continuity.

options.label: A-roll plus B-roll
options.text: Finishing plan: pair the supplied presentation with separately prepared detail shots that illustrate its actual topic.

options.label: Music-led pacing
options.text: Finishing plan: align selected edit points with separately supplied music beats without retiming speech unnaturally.

options.label: Slow-motion accent
options.text: Finishing plan: slow a suitable source section using a separate interpolation step when authorized; retain a clean native-speed generation first.

options.label: Speed ramp
options.text: Finishing plan: use a measured speed ramp on suitable continuous footage after native review, preserving movement endpoints and audio timing.

options.label: Time-lapse assembly
options.text: Finishing plan: compress separately captured or generated process stages into a time-lapse; do not force an entire long process into this native take.

options.label: Freeze-frame accent
options.text: Finishing plan: hold a selected completed source frame briefly at a deliberate point; keep the native take continuously alive.

options.label: Split-screen comparison
options.text: Finishing plan: place separately prepared shots side by side with matched scale and timing; preserve this native take as a full clean frame.

options.label: Photo / video mix
options.text: Finishing plan: combine supplied stills with separate video takes using deliberate timing and stable image framing.

options.label: Clean image / no overlays
options.text: Keep native video clean, with no new captions, logos, watermarks, or interface elements.

options.label: Speech captions later
options.text: Finishing plan: add accurate captions from the user's supplied or verified speech, positioned clear of faces, hands, and Instagram interface areas; generate no lettering in the native take.

options.label: Opening title later
options.text: Finishing plan: add only the user's exact opening title in a video editor, keeping the native take free of generated text.

options.label: Step labels later
options.text: Finishing plan: add the user's exact step labels at the matching demonstrated moments, with readable contrast and adequate reading time.

options.label: Comparison labels later
options.text: Finishing plan: add user-supplied comparison labels to separately prepared states without inventing measurements or claims.

options.label: Closing CTA later
options.text: Finishing plan: add the user's exact closing call to action after the visual payoff, without changing the clean native source.

options.label: Clear interface areas
options.text: Keep essential faces, hands, and the key item away from likely interface-covered edges when the prepared reference framing allows; do not crop or stretch the source automatically.

options.label: Understandable with sound off
options.text: Make the specified visual action readable without audio; any explanatory text is supplied exactly and added during finishing.

options.label: Cover frame later
options.text: Finishing plan: choose a clear frame from the actual completed clip and add only user-approved title text to a separate cover asset.

options.label: Hold the result
options.text: Let the last action settle and hold the supplied result clearly, with natural breathing and small balance adjustments.

options.label: Small smile finish
options.text: Finish the action with a gradual restrained smile and relaxed shoulders rather than a sudden facial change.

options.label: Final lens acknowledgment
options.text: Finish with a brief natural glance toward the lens after the main action has completed.

options.label: Return to starting pose
options.text: Guide the final movement naturally back close to the opening pose and composition without a snap or reversed action.

options.label: Continue beyond frame
options.text: End while a natural action is still continuing smoothly, without a sudden freeze or abrupt body reset.

options.label: Natural exit
options.text: If space permits, {A} finishes the main action and leaves the frame in the specified direction with complete believable steps.

options.label: Place item and release
options.text: End by setting the supplied item down clearly, releasing the grip, and allowing the hands to relax.

options.label: Shared closing reaction
options.text: {A} and {B} finish with a small coordinated reaction and relaxed eyelines while remaining visually distinct.

options.label: Repeatable motion phase
options.text: End the cyclical action near its opening movement phase and speed so a later loop join can be smooth.

options.label: Quiet fabric movement
options.text: When fabric moves visibly, add only restrained soft rustle consistent with the referenced material.

options.label: Nearly inaudible footsteps
options.text: Keep footsteps nearly inaudible below speech or ambience, matching the user-specified surface and indoor or outdoor acoustics.

options.label: Paper / packaging sounds
options.text: For visible package handling, use quiet material-specific folds, paper movement, or small contact sounds without exaggerated crackling.

options.label: Small pour sounds
options.text: For the specified visible pour, use a soft continuous liquid sound that follows the stream and stops with it.

options.label: Gentle tool contact
options.text: For visible tool work, add restrained contact sounds synchronized to actual touches rather than a continuous unrelated sound bed.

options.label: Cup / plate contact
options.text: Use a small realistic contact sound only when the referenced cup or dish visibly touches the specified surface.

options.label: Close ASMR detail
options.text: Use restrained close-miked sounds synchronized to the specified action, with low background noise and no invented whispering.

options.label: No added close foley
options.text: Do not add close foley details; retain only the separately selected overall soundscape.

options.label: IG - Slow dolly out
options.text: The camera retreats slowly along a short smooth path, revealing more of the supplied surroundings without a jump in perspective.

options.label: IG - Push in and settle
options.text: The camera makes a small deliberate push toward the subject, then settles gently before the final beat.

options.label: IG - Subtle handheld
options.text: Use restrained handheld movement with small natural drift, no abrupt shake, and a stable overall horizon.

options.label: IG - Stable selfie follow
options.text: Maintain a believable front-facing phone distance with small coordinated handheld movement and stable facial perspective.

options.label: IG - Follow from behind
options.text: The camera follows the subject from behind at a consistent distance and height with smooth changes of speed.

options.label: IG - Lead the walk
options.text: The camera retreats smoothly ahead of the approaching subject, maintaining a comfortable distance and readable framing.

options.label: IG - Small lateral arc
options.text: The camera moves on a short gentle arc while keeping the subject's scale and the horizon consistent.

options.label: IG - Slow tilt upward
options.text: The camera makes a small deliberate upward tilt to reveal the supplied subject without changing physical camera position.

options.label: IG - Slow tilt downward
options.text: The camera makes a small deliberate downward tilt toward the specified existing detail, then settles.

options.label: IG - Gentle pedestal rise
options.text: The camera rises a short distance vertically with smooth acceleration, keeping the subject centered without an orbit.

options.label: IG - Gentle pedestal lower
options.text: The camera lowers a short distance vertically while retaining a stable lens direction and smooth motion.

options.label: IG - Gentle focus shift
options.text: Keep the camera stationary and shift focus slowly between two user-specified existing depth planes without changing facial or object geometry.

options.label: IG - Reel-safe prepared frame
options.text: Use a prepared 9:16 composition only when the supplied inputs and workflow already support it; retain full important action and do not stretch, silently crop, or override the reference aspect ratio.

options.label: IG - Three-quarter body
options.text: Frame the subject from head to below the knees with comfortable hand and head margins when the prepared reference supports this view.

options.label: IG - Face and hands
options.text: Keep the face and active hands visible together without distorting perspective or cutting off the demonstrated gesture.

options.label: IG - Existing object detail
options.text: Use a clear detail view of the specified referenced object while maintaining its physical proportions and context.

options.label: IG - Environmental portrait
options.text: Include the subject and enough of the supplied environment to explain the activity, without adding unseen rooms or scenery.

options.label: IG - Space for later text
options.text: When the existing framing allows, retain a clear area beside the main action for later captions without removing reference objects.

options.label: IG - Footwork readability
options.text: Keep head, hands, and complete foot placements within the prepared frame throughout the selected movement.

options.label: IG - Tabletop activity
options.text: Keep the relevant working surface, hands, and specified items readable with comfortable edges around the action.

options.label: IG - Soft window key
options.text: Change only the lighting to a soft window-like key with gentle directional shadow and stable exposure; retain all reference scene contents.

options.label: IG - Overcast softness
options.text: Change only the lighting to broad diffuse overcast-style illumination with restrained contrast and stable skin tones.

options.label: IG - Golden-hour warmth
options.text: Change only the lighting to low warm directional illumination with believable shadow relationships and controlled highlights.

options.label: IG - Blue-hour coolness
options.text: Change only the lighting to soft cool ambient illumination with restrained warm practical accents if such fixtures already exist.

options.label: IG - Soft studio key
options.text: Change only the lighting to a broad soft key and gentle fill, preserving identity, scene layout, and plausible shadows.

options.label: IG - Restrained rim light
options.text: Change only the lighting to include a modest rim separating the subject from the existing background without glowing outlines.

options.label: IG - Soft frontal creator light
options.text: Change only the lighting to a soft frontal creator-light treatment with restrained catchlights and natural facial texture.

options.label: IG - Existing practical lights
options.text: Use the reference's existing visible fixtures as motivated light sources with stable brightness and no newly invented lamps.

options.label: IG - Controlled side light
options.text: Change only the lighting to a controlled side key with readable shadow detail and no exposure pulsing.

options.label: IG - Friendly / approachable
options.text: {A} uses relaxed eye contact, a small welcoming smile, and easy shoulder movement.

options.label: IG - Playful
options.text: {A} uses a light eyebrow change and a small amused smile with restrained, readable physical timing.

options.label: IG - Thoughtful
options.text: {A} pauses briefly, shifts the eyes toward the specified point of interest, and settles into a composed expression.

options.label: IG - Small surprise
options.text: {A} notices the specified event with a modest eye and brow response, then lets the expression settle naturally.

options.label: IG - Understated amusement
options.text: A small smile develops after the user-specified payoff, with a brief natural shoulder or breath response.

options.label: IG - Focused on task
options.text: {A} keeps attention on the specified activity with small gaze corrections and purposeful, restrained gestures.

options.label: IG - Calm / reassuring
options.text: {A} uses gentle eye contact, measured movement, and an unforced expression with no exaggerated emotional shift.

options.label: IG - Bold editorial
options.text: {A} uses a steady gaze, composed chin position, and controlled confident movement without a rigid frozen pose.

options.label: IG - Reserved / shy
options.text: {A} briefly glances away, makes a small natural posture adjustment, and returns toward a soft expression.

options.label: IG - Stand and adjust
options.text: {A} remains standing while making small natural balance and posture adjustments without taking unnecessary steps.

options.label: IG - Light supported lean
options.text: If the reference includes a suitable support, {A} makes a light comfortable lean with visible contact and stable balance.

options.label: IG - Rise from seat
options.text: {A} leans forward slightly, transfers weight through the feet, and rises from the referenced seat smoothly.

options.label: IG - Reach and return
options.text: {A} reaches toward the specified existing item with a plausible arm path, completes the action, and returns naturally.

options.label: IG - Lift supplied item
options.text: {A} takes a believable grip on the supplied item, lifts it with appropriate weight, and holds it steadily.

options.label: IG - Turn and walk away
options.text: {A} makes a natural pivot and takes a few complete steps away in the user-specified available direction.

options.label: IG - Small side step
options.text: {A} makes one modest side step, transfers weight fully, and settles without sliding the feet.

options.label: IG - Look then body turn
options.text: {A}'s gaze leads a small head turn, followed smoothly by the shoulders and torso, with natural balance.

options.label: IG - Greet partner
options.text: {A} notices {B}, turns slightly toward them, and gives a restrained greeting gesture without invented dialogue.

options.label: IG - Item handoff
options.text: {A} offers the supplied item to {B}; both maintain distinct hands and believable grip transfer before releasing.

options.label: IG - Brisk but readable
options.text: Use a brisk natural cadence with one clear main action, complete contact points, and a controlled ending.

options.label: IG - Compact gesture
options.text: Fit a small simple gesture comfortably inside {duration} seconds rather than rushing several complex actions.

options.label: IG - Relaxed creator pace
options.text: Allow small natural pauses around the main gesture while keeping the performance alive throughout.

options.label: IG - Steady rhythmic timing
options.text: Use an even repeated physical rhythm without assuming an external soundtrack or exact beat synchronization.

options.label: IG - Deliberate demonstration
options.text: Slow the performance enough to show each meaningful contact and outcome clearly, retaining natural real-time physics.

options.label: IG - Quiet studio
options.text: Use low neutral room tone appropriate to the supplied studio-like space, with no generated speech or music.

options.label: IG - Subtle home ambience
options.text: Use restrained indoor room tone consistent with the user-described space, without inventing appliances or off-screen voices.

options.label: IG - Cafe texture
options.text: When a cafe soundscape is requested, use low indistinct room activity and small distant contact sounds without intelligible speech.

options.label: IG - Urban exterior
options.text: When an urban exterior is specified, use restrained distant city activity, keeping the foreground action clear and avoiding sudden horns.

options.label: IG - Garden / park
options.text: When a garden or park is specified, use soft outdoor air and occasional restrained natural sounds without a dense unrelated chorus.

options.label: IG - Waterfront
options.text: When a waterfront is specified, use soft water movement and gentle open-air ambience without changing the visible setting.

options.label: IG - Quiet kitchen
options.text: Use restrained kitchen room tone and only physical sounds matched to the specified visible activity.

options.label: IG - Dry close recording
options.text: Use a quiet, dry acoustic bed with minimal reverberation and no invented dialogue or background song.

options.label: IG - Original light pop instrumental
options.text: Generate an original instrumental pop bed with a light steady mid-tempo pulse, restrained bass, and no vocals or recognizable melody.

options.label: IG - Original soft house instrumental
options.text: Generate an original understated house-style instrumental with a steady dance pulse, soft percussion, and restrained synth texture; no vocals.

options.label: IG - Original lo-fi instrumental
options.text: Generate an original relaxed lo-fi instrumental with a soft slow-to-mid-tempo groove, muted keys, and restrained percussion; no vocals.

options.label: IG - Original light funk instrumental
options.text: Generate an original light funk instrumental with a clean rhythmic bass figure and modest percussion at a medium tempo; no vocals.

options.label: IG - Original mellow R&B instrumental
options.text: Generate an original mellow R&B-style instrumental with warm chords, restrained bass, and a relaxed medium-slow pulse; no vocals.

options.label: IG - Original restrained cinematic bed
options.text: Generate an original slow cinematic instrumental with sustained soft textures, modest piano, and no dramatic swell or vocals.

options.label: IG - Original reflective piano
options.text: Generate an original sparse piano instrumental at a slow tempo with gentle dynamics and no vocals.

options.label: IG - Original percussion groove
options.text: Generate an original light percussion-only groove at a medium tempo with space around physical sound and no vocals.

options.label: IG - Add chosen music in editor
options.text: No generated background music. Finishing plan: add a separately supplied or appropriately licensed track later; no source audio or trending song is assumed to be copied.

options.label: IG - Exact script added separately
options.text: Do not invent spoken words or lip-sync. Finishing plan: record or supply the exact user-approved narration separately, then synchronize it where needed.

options.label: IG - Expressive without speech
options.text: Use facial expression and gestures without articulated speech, sung lyrics, or invented dialogue.

options.label: IG - Supplied speech only
options.text: Generate speech only when the user separately supplies exact words, language, speaker order, and delivery using the official dialogue syntax; otherwise remain nonverbal.

options.label: IG - Supplied lip-sync audio later
options.text: Treat lip-sync as a separate explicitly supplied audio and synchronization task; do not infer words or audio reuse from a reference video's mere presence.
